variant.briefing:
Urgent ship aid needed at [Location]. A band of destructive criminal outlaws that have been trying to make a name for themselves recently has struck hard against one of our high priority clients, attacking their ships and targeting the client's [Objects]. It will be your job to keep everyone and everything safe – though it won't be an easy feat.

I cannot stress enough how dangerous these attackers are, so be sure to bring backup to deal with them. If you, the crew, and the infrastructures make it out intact, we’re offering a generous sum of [ScripAmount]  MG Scrip to the main contractor. 

Best of luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
